title: Dragon Memories Manager
summary: SillyTavern group roleplay addon that records editable, character-specific episodic memories and relies on Presence to filter witnessed messages.
documentation_observations: README explicitly warns that without Presence it cannot know who witnessed messages and may summarize everything for everyone.
Memories can be edited, reactivated, expired and exported to a character-filtered lorebook entry; default all-remember-all mode is not isolated.
limitations: Documentation reviewed, but no local install or independent performance/privacy test has been run; memory separation and adult-content compatibility require explicit reproduction.
